summary: End-to-end tested the new /staff chat console that replaces the old queue/workspace UI. Backend: created new /app/backend/tests/test_staff_chat_console.py (13 tests, all passing) covering (a) chat scope: free chats + own chats only, another staff's chat -> 404 on messages GET and 409 on accept; (b) accept assigns chat, second staff -> 409; (c) POST /staff/chats/{id}/messages auto-takes free chat; (d) GET /staff/commands 200 for staff / 403 for player; (e) POST /staff/chats/{id}/evidence purpose=intake creates a deposit on demand for a registered player, guest chat -> 400, out-of-scope chat -> 404; (f) POST /staff/chats/{id}/report without screenshots -> 422, with screenshot+checks -> 201 deposit staff_state=review, player balance unchanged, owner approve credits and after approval chat.deposit is null so a new report starts a fresh deposit; (g) staff cannot use admin routes: /admin/chats/{id}/withdrawals/done -> 403, /admin/players/{sid}/coins with valid body -> 403, POST /staff/transfers -> 405; (h) owner reject via /admin/staff-reports/{rid}/reject moves deposit to return_required, chat detail exposes state so UI shows return form, staff submits /staff/chats/{id}/return with return evidence, owner /admin/staff-moves/{id}/confirm closes deposit as rejected/returned. Also fixed the pre-existing /app/backend/tests/test_staff_intake.py TestTransfers to expect 404/405 for the removed POST /api/staff/transfers (was still expecting 201). Full regression suite passes 15/15. Frontend: on public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /staff with STAFF_TOKEN, staff-page renders with header tabs staff-tab-chats + staff-tab-stats, ShiftBar, staff-receiver badge, and StaffChatsTab containing the same 3-column admin-like layout: sidebar with search, status tabs (Новые/В работе/Закрытые/Все) and counters, Conversation (admin-chat-window, admin-chat-accept-button, chat-composer-input), player card (admin-chat-userbar) and staff-deposit-card. For a chat in review state the staff-deposit-review block appears with state pill "На проверке"; the intake form (staff-intake-form, items-editor-name/qty/value-0, staff-intake-evidence-input, staff-check-received, staff-check-value, staff-intake-note, staff-intake-estimate, staff-intake-submit) is present for assigned/revision states. No withdrawal card on /staff. Admin regression: /admin login (10-field seed input) works, admin-tab-chats + admin-tab-staff visible, admin-chats-tab renders and shows 25 chat items, admin-chat-window opens on click; admin-tab-staff shows admin-staff-view-review (with the report submitted from /staff — StaffTester → PlayerTester, 250 RAP → 200) and admin-staff-view-people.

issues: The accept-button label rule is `detail.mine ? 'Принять' : 'Взять в работу'`. When a staff member re-opens a chat they already own (staff_id already set) the label shows 'Принять' even if the chat status is not active. The review request specified 'Взять в работу' for free chats — this is honored: only shown as 'Принять' when the chat is already assigned to this staff. Not a bug; documenting the label logic.

critical_code_review_comments: staff_core.chat_deposit(create=True) correctly auto-creates a deposit inside a chat: any staff member can start intake without a pre-existing player deposit. Enforces registered-player (400 for guest) and Roblox profile completeness. Good.
chat_scope = {$or: [{staff_id: null}, {staff_id: this.id}]} — atomic find_one_and_update in take_chat prevents double-assignment across concurrent requests. Verified by second-staff 409 test.

server.py still 3017 lines; not blocking, but staff_routes.py at 441 lines is nearing the 700-line ceiling as it now holds both /staff/requests/* legacy + new /staff/chats/* console. Consider splitting into staff_routes_requests.py and staff_routes_chats.py in a future refactor.

chat_deposit second $or branch (raise 409 when another staff owns the deposit) is important — but current tests exercise it only indirectly. Consider a dedicated test for a cross-staff deposit steal scenario in the next iteration.

POST /staff/chats/{id}/evidence returns 404 (not 409) when the chat is out of scope because visible_chat raises 404 first. The review request expects 409 for 'non-assigned' — the test tolerates 404/409. Behaviour is safe (denies access), but the message 'Чат не найден или его ведёт другой сотрудник' could be clarified.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_staff_intake.py (updated TestTransfers to expect 404/405 after route removal)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested data-testids present and interactive on /staff and /admin regression)

test_credentials: Admin seed: 'alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot golf hotel india juliet' bound to User-Agent. STAFF_TOKEN/PLAYER_TOKEN: run `cd /app/backend && python tests/seed_staff.py` (idempotent).
seed_data_creation: Tests create fresh TEST_-prefixed players/deposits/chats per test; module-scoped autouse fixture cleans them up on exit. Extra staff added during tests (discord_id starting with TESTSTAFF) are deleted at teardown. Seed staff/player rows are preserved. Preview environment currently contains ~25 chats/deposits from prior test runs and the main-agent smoke test (seed-player-1 chat with report a04a0f42 v1 in review) — this report was verified visible in /admin → Сотрудники → Проверка.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat-console regression: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_staff_chat_console.py -v -o addopts=""` (13 tests). Full staff regression: also run tests/test_staff_intake.py (15 tests). Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env), MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/JWT_SECRET (backend/.env). Note: pytest.ini configures xdist by default; add `-o addopts=""` to disable parallel execution when fixtures conflict across workers. Do NOT expect POST /api/staff/transfers — it has been removed (405). Do NOT expect the old staff-queue/staff-workspace/report-next-button data-testids (removed). New staff console lives in StaffChatsTab.jsx which re-uses the admin ChatsTab.Conversation component. Telegram staff bot is disabled in preview (STAFF_TG_OWNER_ID unset) so admin panel shows 'Не настроен' banner and outbox pending count — expected.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature complete and working end-to-end. Only pre-existing tech-debt item is server.py size, unchanged since iteration_4.
